interpretation.split_7_2: GG≈0.146 ZZ≈0.094–0.096 GZ≈ZZ ZG≈0.101; both cross-arms recover nearly full zonal gain
interpretation.loocv_means: GG 0.180 ZZ 0.098 GZ 0.098 ZG 0.101; 9/9 all three beat GG
interpretation.vs_mapping_only_hypothesis: NOT confirmed as unique: GZ≈ZZ and ZG≈ZZ, so zoning either EOF or GP stage suffices under these approximations
interpretation.with_oracle: Equal-budget pure-EOF oracle still has DeltaRMSE<0; therefore LSG gain is not pure HF truncation, but stage-swap does not uniquely pin zone-private GPs
interpretation.recommended_wording: Zone structure in the coupled LF-to-HF pipeline (EOF coordinates and/or mapping locality) recovers the Carlisle LSG gain; not uniquely the GP stage.
